scope.zh: 将 JCEF 首次构造从 Holder 类初始化移入原有同步 getInstance 路径，保持代理设置与凭据处理不变，避免服务请求发生在类初始化栈中。
preserves: Original JCEF constructor, support checks, proxy settings/credentials and migration service calls
Single first-use construction, cached-null behavior, existing test-mode retry path and guarded publication
Unexpected first-attempt failure remains terminal and retains its original cause on subsequent calls
excludes: No disabled Markdown, JCEF, proxy or service registration
No logger suppression, preload race, cache reset or configuration deletion
No writes to authenticated SDK or installed/reference app
No additional filesystem/process operations on the event dispatch thread

verification.scope: Authenticated source replay and exact class/JAR entry verification; actual restored Markdown behavior remains a separate native runtime check
